name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1504: Konyo mandate that was still open: nothing important under 12 to 13px at fullscreen. The root scale already declared fs-2xs at 13px as the smallest anything may render and the visual lock keeps weights honest, but a raw font-size 10px slipped past both because neither gate looked at size. Three surfaces were under the floor and two of them were the G5 card - the buttons that decide whether the third eye runs, and the line that says why it is not running. A warning nobody can read is not a warning. All three now use the token, and a gate fails on any raw px under 13.
